=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:854-1084,1561-1616 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The P3 done-check support was added only to the template hook. That covers `_read_target_file`, `_parse_targets`, `_merge_explicit_tests`, `_name_failed` / `_target_status`, the `run_gate(..., explicit_tests=..., expect_baseline_fail=...)` changes and `--tests-file` / `--expect-baseline-fail-file`. The live `.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` copy was not changed, and no divergence entry was added.
  WHY: CI run 41418807937 fails `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py::test_live_copies_match_their_templates` (job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator) on head bc225f54. The aggregate `lint` check fails as a result, and the seven new persistence test files at ci.yml lines 669-675 never run. The source severity BLOCKER maps to critical. This is the same root cause as the next entry, which is listed separately because it cites a different file.
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:847-853 (whole file, 1,425 lines) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The live copy has none of the P3 additions: no `_read_target_file`, no `_parse_targets`, no `_merge_explicit_tests`, no `_name_failed`/`_target_status`, no `--tests-file` / `--expect-baseline-fail-file`, no `acceptance` map, and the old `run_gate` signature. It is also not allowlisted in `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json`.
  WHY: `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py:41-54` fails with "Live .claude/ copies differ from workflow-templates/.claude/ for: hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py", because `CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:626`) is empty. That fails `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` (run 41418807937, job 125189104052) and the aggregate `lint` check. The seven new P1-P11 test files at `ci.yml:662-675` never execute. Both reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:794-812 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `cmd_check` fetches `ai:verify-pending` issues once with `per_page=50` and no pagination. GitHub's default order is newest-created first, and `_candidates()` / `rotate_window()` (775-785) only work over that single page.
  WHY: Once more than 50 issues carry the label, issues past the first page are never graded and never cleaned (`cleanup_disabled` 586-602 runs only when the switch is off), so stale labels build up and the oldest checks miss their PERSIST_POSTMERGE_WINDOW_HOURS window. `rotate_window`'s docstring guarantee is false past page 1. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR. Confidence ranged 3-4. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash also filed a second, duplicate PERFORMANCE entry for the same root cause.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19563-19583 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `run_persist_postmerge_verify` can fail to post `/answer` (`outcome=error reason=answer_post_failed`, 19580-19582) or hit the `phase_capped` deferral (19565-19567). It does so after `scripts/persist_postmerge_verify.py:738-771` has already reopened the issue into `ai:planning`, posted the recurred marker and removed `ai:verify-pending`. Nothing records that a re-plan is still owed.
  WHY: The issue is no longer a P5 candidate and sits in `ai:planning` with no `/answer`. Recovery depends on the P6 governor or standalone stall recovery (default 120 minutes), and it waits indefinitely when `ENABLE_STANDALONE_STALL_RECOVERY=false` and `PERSIST_BUDGET_ENABLED` is off. All three reviewers rated it NIT; confidence ranged 3-4.
- scripts/attempt_journal.py:~470 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `load_comments()` reads the issue's entire comment history with `--paginate` and no page bound, and five stage writers call `append`.
  WHY: Each `append` costs one HTTP request per 100 comments, not the documented "at most 1 comments read", so API cost grows with the issue's history. Source severity was NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

The repo's template/live parity contract requires the matching `.claude/` live copy to change in the same PR or be listed in `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json`.
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py (or .github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither path is in pr_changed_files.txt / the PR changed-files list. Only the template carries the ~267-line P3 hunk set. The live copy has no `--tests-file` / `--expect-baseline-fail-file` / `_parse_targets` / `explicit_tests` support, while the template has `run_gate(..., explicit_tests, expect_baseline_fail)` at lines 1000-1023 (1625 lines vs. 1425). The live copy is absent from `.github/ai/claude_template_divergence.json`. The parity test fails on PR head bc225f542f9023fa74589c25decd4869a1ca8431 (run 41418807937, job 125189104052), and the seven new test files at .github/workflows/ci.yml:669-675 never ran.
- requirement: "Implement Phase P1-P11 of the persistent unattended workflows plan (ref #8427)"
  expected_change_site: n/a
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]

- requirement: Third-party check `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` failed (run 41418843932) with `custom_instructions_too_large` (status 422).
  expected_change_site: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md size
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: This PR changes neither file. The log shows third-party infrastructure failures, and the instructions are assembled from AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md, which the twelve pending agents.d fragments only reach at the release-time fold. The reviewer said this is not attributable to a diff defect.
